claims.notes: THE SECOND REPRINT of the 1 October 1834 Chicago letter list, at page 3 columns 2-3 of this issue, and its names are NOT minted here either — they are minted once, from 1834-10-22. What this printing adds is negative evidence worth having: page 3 column 2 carries the list's LEFT sub-column as a sliver of surnames with the forenames cut ('Abell, S', 'Atwate', 'Beilly,', 'Bryant,'), which confirms that the surnames run A-L down that column and confirms that no October witness can give those entries a forename. That is why 1834-10-22's column 1 leaves 130 entries unminted rather than supplied.
